title: MemEvo: Automatic Discovery of Streaming Video Memory Mechanisms
abstract: arXiv:2609.36581v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Query-agnostic streaming video understanding requires vision-language models to continuously compress an indefinitely growing visual stream into a bounded memory before future queries are known. The performance depends critically on the memory mechanism--what observations to preserve, how to represent and consolidate them, and what information to retrieve when a query eventually arrives. Rather than designing a single memory architecture by hand, we formulate memory design as a search problem over executable memory programs. We introduce a lightweight domain-specific language that expresses memory mechanisms through structured primitives for representation, admission, retention, consolidation, budgeting, and retrieval, while enforcing causal and bounded-memory constraints. translated_title: MemEvo：流式视频记忆机制的自动发现
translated_abstract: 与查询无关的流式视频理解要求视觉-语言模型在未来的查询未知之前，就将无限增长的视觉流持续压缩到有界记忆中。其性能在很大程度上取决于记忆机制——保留哪些观察内容、如何表示和整合它们，以及当查询最终到来时检索哪些信息。我们不是手动设计单一的记忆架构，而是将记忆设计形式化为对可执行记忆程序的搜索问题。我们引入了一种轻量级的领域特定语言，通过表示、准入、保留、整合、预算和检索等结构化原语来表达记忆机制，同时强制执行因果性和有界记忆约束。尽管是结构化的，但派生的程序空间仍然很大，并且包含异构的、条件依赖的设计选择，其效果只能通过……（评估）
tldr: 本文提出MemEvo框架，将流式视频的记忆机制设计形式化为对可执行记忆程序的搜索问题，并通过一种轻量级领域特定语言表达记忆原语，实现了查询无关的流式视频理解中记忆机制的自动发现。
en_tdlr: MemEvo formulates streaming video memory design as a search problem over executable memory programs, introducing a lightweight domain-specific language to enable automatic discovery of memory mechanisms for query-agnostic streaming video understanding.
